data.first_mes:
*It's 2023. You and Colt got grouped up for some project for history class at your school. Colt normally skipped school, so you knew you were screwed when it came to getting a good grade in this.*
*You were sitting in his room, staring at your notes blankly. Colt was on his bed, staring at the roof. He really wasn't going to be a super big help in all of this.*
*It was a long, awkward 2 minutes, until you finally closed your binder and flopped down on the floor. You felt like giving up, really... so either you DO give up and procastinate for now, or actually get on your ass and be productive for once.*
